question: how much registration fee can be reimbursed for presenting a paper at an external conference and what are the conditions
answer: A faculty member can request reimbursement of the registration fee for an external (non-CMRIT) Scopus indexed conference up to a maximum of Rs. 8,000, for one paper in an academic year. Pre-approval from the Principal must be taken before remitting the fee, and the reimbursement claim must be made within a month after attending the conference. No other incentive can be claimed for the paper whose registration fee is reimbursed.

question: my conference paper has three cmrit authors who can claim the registration fee and what is required
answer: If multiple authors of the paper are from CMRIT, only the faculty member who presents the paper can claim the amount, and all other CMRIT authors must give a no objection signature to the presenting author while taking pre-approval. The pre-approval form also needs the DRC Head to verify that the conference is Scopus indexed, and the faculty must have cleared the DRC and RC review process. The reimbursement is up to Rs. 8,000 for one paper in an academic year, and no other incentive can be claimed for that paper.

question: how is the kapila grant released to the institute
answer: The final decision on a KAPILA application is taken by the MoE's Innovation Cell (MIC), based on the expert committee's recommendations and the availability of funds for the scheme. After MIC's approval, the total sanctioned grant is sent to the institute on reimbursement mode.

question: what incentive can i claim for a paper published in a scopus q1 or q2 journal
answer: A faculty member can claim Rs. 15,000 for a paper in a Scopus Q1 journal and Rs. 10,000 for a paper in a Scopus Q2 journal, whether the journal is free or paid. The quartile is verified on the Scimago Journal Ranking website, and the paper's subject area should fall in Q1/Q2 under the journal's sub-category.

question: how much incentive is given for a patent grant and how is it shared
answer: An incentive of Rs. 25,000 can be claimed for a patent grant (Indian or non-Indian utility patent) for AY 2026-27. The incentive is divided equally among all the CMRIT inventors of the patent.

question: how many days does the rc review process take
answer: The RC review process takes 5 working days, made up of 3 days for department review and 2 days for cross department review. Faculty may send reminders to the RC or DRC if there is a delay.

question: how much other incentive can a faculty member claim if they worked at cmrit for 7 months in an academic year
answer: Faculty working at CMRIT for more than nine months in an academic year can claim Rs. 3,000. For shorter durations the claim is Rs. 750, Rs. 1,500 and Rs. 2,250 for less than 3 months, 6 months and 9 months of experience respectively, so a faculty member with 7 months of service falls in the less than 9 months bracket and can claim Rs. 2,250.

question: how much does a 5 lakh uba proposal and a 20 lakh modrob proposal count for in the core load
answer: UBA, MSME and GI proposals have a weightage of 0.3, so a Rs. 5 lakh UBA proposal counts as Rs. 1.5 lakhs. STTP, FDP and MODROB proposals have a weightage of 0.1, so a Rs. 20 lakh MODROB proposal counts as Rs. 2 lakhs for core load calculations.

question: how much funding is needed to complete one consultancy load and how many research papers make one rp load
answer: The RCPIE FAQ only points to the 2020-2021 targets, so the current figures come from the RCPIE Targets for 2026-27. One consultancy sub-unit is equivalent to Rs. 50K received by CMRIT, and the target is 3 consultancy sub-units per year for one core unit. For research papers, one sub-unit is equivalent to one published paper and the target is 2 research papers per year for one core unit.

question: how many days will it take to get approval from the drc and the rc
answer: The FAQ gives two different timings. One answer says DRC approval takes a minimum of 5 days and RC approval a minimum of 2 days. Another says the RC review process takes 5 working days in total, with 3 days for department review and 2 days for cross department review. If no comments or approval arrive within the specified time, the faculty member should write an email to the RC Convenor immediately.

question: what font style and size should be used in the final year project review presentation and how long can the introduction be
answer: The final year project review template specifies Times New Roman with font size 20. The introduction should not extend more than two slides and the objective should not extend more than one slide.

question: what is the approval process for a mega project mep
answer: A Mega Project (MEP) is presented at the RC meeting. The I&E/CoE/DRC head (Verifier-1) and the Head of Department (Verifier-2) review the project and the two forms, and if they are satisfied they sign Form-1 and send both forms (Form-1 pre-screening and Form-2 project proposal) to the Associate Director-Academics for further action. An MEP is meant for existing technology or deployment, moving towards consultancy or a startup.

question: what affiliation should i use in research papers
answer: The affiliation to be used in research papers and proposals is "CMR Institute of Technology, Bengaluru". Faculty who are not pursuing a Ph.D. should write "Designation, Department, CMR Institute of Technology, Bengaluru". If a journal does not accept the prescribed formats, the faculty member should inform the Research Committee before proceeding, but the affiliation "CMR Institute of Technology, Bengaluru" must still be present.

question: what is the maximum plagiarism allowed in a paper for rc review
answer: Plagiarism of the paper should not exceed 20 percent, including the reference section. It is checked during the DRC and RC review.

question: what is the last date to upload rcpie proofs in the drive
answer: The last date to upload proofs in the Drive is 30th June of every year. The DRC Head verification deadline is 5th July, the RC verification deadline is 15th July, and the RCPIE verification details are submitted to the Principal/HoD by the RC on 18th July.

question: which affiliation should a faculty member use if they are pursuing a phd at the cmrit research center affiliated to vtu
answer: CMRIT faculty members pursuing research in the CMRIT research center affiliated to VTU should use "Research Scholar, Department (VTU RC), CMR Institute of Technology, Bengaluru".

question: what proofs need to be uploaded for c load and e load verification
answer: For C load the proofs are the pre-approval letter, receipt, participants list, expenses and load sharing details if required. For E load the same documents are needed, plus the MCA registered start-up proof. For C and E loads only a CMRIT receipt with the accountant's signature is accepted as proof.

question: can i send only an abstract for rc review
answer: The documents give different eligibility criteria. For a paper, the Checklist for RC Submission requires two Scopus indexed Q1 or Q2 papers as first author, the FAQ requires that any one of the first three authors has a publication in a Scopus Q1 or Q2 journal, and the RCPIE Targets require a minimum of three Scopus Q3/Q4 publications as first author. For a proposal, the Checklist requires a sanctioned proposal of at least Rs. 5 lakhs as PI or Co-PI, and the FAQ requires that the PI has received a grant of at least Rs. 5 lakhs. In every case the journals must be active in Scopus at the time of submission.

question: is wiley a recommended book publisher
answer: Yes. Wiley Publishers is one of the twelve recommended book publishers, along with McGraw Hill, Pearson, Emerald Group Publishing, Macmillan Learning, Routledge Taylor and Francis Group, Oxford University Press, Sage Publications, CRC Press, Springer Nature, Cambridge University Press and Thomson Reuters.

question: what is the principal's email address
answer: The provided documents do not contain the Principal's email address.
